reasoning: This is a manuscript of canonical Sephardi-rite liturgy (standard mahzor prayers), not a distinct translatable work. English translations of this same liturgy exist from 1761 (Isaac Pinto, New York) and continuously since. The manuscript is also incomplete and severely damaged. First-English claim is ill-posed for canonical liturgy.
